text.en: Please don't touch the ice pieces. They're almost a word.
text.zh-CN: 先别碰那些冰片。就快拼成一个词了。

text.en: Your fighting notes have a suspiciously large blank in the middle.
text.zh-CN: 你的战技笔记中间，好像空了很大一块。

text.en: A friendly match might help. We can test the parts you still have.
text.zh-CN: 不如友好切磋一场，先试试你手头还有的部分。

text.en: Two pages are missing. If the answer is 'duck,' I'd rather learn it now.
text.zh-CN: 少了两页。要是上面写着‘记得低头’，最好现在就让我学会。

text.en: Well fought. I'm Kai. I suspect the missing pages covered that.
text.zh-CN: 打得漂亮。我叫凯。我怀疑少掉的那两页正好讲这个。

text.en: Let's find them before you have to improvise the rest.
text.zh-CN: 一起找回来吧，免得后面全靠你临场发挥。

text.en: Gladly. If Gerda asks, this was studying. Definitely not getting knocked over.
text.zh-CN: 好。要是格尔达问起，就说我在学习，绝不是被人打趴下了。

text.en: Let's call that a first draft. Check your footing before the next one.
text.zh-CN: 这回就算初稿。下次先看准脚下。

答应帮胡斐找回两页刀法。.en: Kai joined the party. We agreed to look for two missing pages from his fighting notes.
答应帮胡斐找回两页刀法。.zh-CN: 凯加入队伍，我们答应帮他找回战技笔记缺失的两页。
